name: construction
description: Claude Code skills for the construction phase — Procore-native workflows plus a Procore MCP toolkit. Read project dashboards, review and grade daily logs, snapshot RFI/submittal health, chase overdue responses, batch-import observations from field reports, log manpower/calls/correspondence, review submittals against specs, distribute change events, and write RFIs — all with dry-run write safety. Merges the former project-management and site-operations plugins.
